# Panda R1 capture contract

Use the two archived endpoints from the successful rotated-box run, record indices 479 and 2159 at 0.30 s and 1.35 s. Both independent finger coordinates, payload pose, physical table dimensions, model digest and original record ordering come from the archived input. The replay adapter creates an archive-local namespace. Its revision and tick identify archive records. They do not identify a publication by a live physics process.

Use the manufacturer's full-resolution link/finger geometry with its original visual offsets. Cube and tabletop have the dimensions declared by the source. The floor and the support under the finite tabletop are visual set dressing, attached to the fixed base. Record their membership. Keep geometry, camera, exposure and frame fixed across the single directional light and studio comparison. The fixed 960 × 720 camera is at (1.27, −0.86, 0.79) m, aims at (0.10, 0, 0.43) m and uses a 1150 px focal length. The virtual 640 × 480 wrist camera is attached to the hand at (0.095, 0, −0.025) m in hand coordinates, looks at (0, 0, 0.138) m in that frame and uses a 440 px focal length. Clip at 0.005 and 5 m. Axis convention is right, up, −Z forward. The wrist is a simulated camera with a declared extrinsic.

Freeze three material points before inspecting device output. On the base, hand and one finger, pick the centroid of one original mesh triangle visible in both fixed-camera poses, prefer the largest common projected area, and break ties by instance/triangle order. Use an independent Panda homogeneous chain and analytic rays against the full scene. Record the chosen source instance, triangle and local point, and keep it for both poses. In the actual unmarked raster images verify the visible material owner and forward depth at the nearest pixel centre. In a separate fiducial exposure measure the silhouette centre of a small round marker attached to that material point under the same motion. Every fixed-view marker must be observed in both poses, maximum Euclidean reprojection error ≤1 px. Keep diagnostic marks off the beauty images. Draw the URDF's collision primitives as a separate wireframe view.

An unreadable mesh, wrong world or wrong revision must give an error; no physics stepping. Save the fixed-camera pair, labelled wrist views, diagnostic overlays, actual frame and configuration identities, measurements and limitations. Evaluate the original native triangle admission on the full scene; any smaller native view must name its subset. G3 calibration, R2 speed/quality and R3 full sensor qualification retain their own results and criteria.
